name: Leaf Storm
description: You whip up a powerful storm of leaves in a 40 foot circle, centered on a point within range. All creatures in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. After activating this move, you are sapped of energy. On any damaging move you activate before the end of your next turn, reduce the damage dealt by your MOVE modifier.
